textLines: [302] redirect to https://sso.example.com/realms/ops/protocol/openid-connect/auth (engine default). The engine URL redirects, and redirects are never followed: point the engine URL at the REST API root itself (e.g. https:// when the server redirects from http://). A redirect to a login page means the engine credentials are missing or expired.
